about_the_game:
⚠️ Demo-only notice

This demo is conversation-only.
It lets you chat naturally with LocalHelper.ai, ask general questions, or check things like the current time and date. System-level commands and automation are disabled here.
Upgrade to the full version to unlock a rich library of voice commands for controlling your PC and smart devices.

🧠 About This Application

LocalHelper.ai is your private, voice-enabled AI assistant for home and office — running entirely on your computer, with zero cloud traffic.

It keeps you productive, answers questions in a flash, and (in the full edition) controls apps, windows, and peripherals — all through natural speech or text. Your data never leaves your PC.

🚀 Early Access

LocalHelper is still in Early Access, and we’re expanding capabilities every month. Try the core experience now and help shape future features.

Share ideas or vote on upcoming functions on our forum — or straight from the program menu!

✨ Key Features in this Demo

  • 🗣️ Talk or type — the assistant listens and responds naturally

  • 🔒 100 % offline — complete privacy, no accounts or subscriptions

  • 🧠 Instant answers & summaries for everyday questions

  • 💡 Community-driven roadmap — your feedback guides development

  • 📎 Lightweight — runs on a single PC without extra setup

LocalHelper is perfect for privacy-conscious users, remote workers, or anyone who wants an AI assistant without surrendering their data — and the full version takes it even further with powerful automation tools.

content_descriptors.notes: This product includes a voice/text AI assistant that responds freely to user prompts. While it does not contain built-in sexual or violent content, the AI may generate responses that involve adult themes — such as sexual language, suggestive dialogue, or mature discussions — depending on the user's input. The developer does not promote or encourage such use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 30xx GPU with 8 GB VRAM with latest drivers
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device; USB or built-in audio interface
  • Additional Notes: Microphone with good sensitivity and clarity required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 or better (8 GB+ VRAM recommended)
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High-quality onboard audio or dedicated USB audio interface
  • Additional Notes: Use of high-quality condenser microphone and quiet environment strongly improves voice interaction

short_description: 🧠 DEMO — Chat with your private AI assistant: ask questions, get quick answers, check time & date. (Voice-controlled PC commands are available in the full version.) 🔒 100 % offline — no internet, no accounts, no clouds. 🚀 Early Access — suggest features and help shape the future of LocalHelper!
